name: com.kobapps.localizationkit
description: Localization for Unity with source-generated bindings. Mark a string field with [Localized("key")] and it is filled in and kept in step with the active language automatically; mark one with [LocalizationKey] to get a searchable key picker in the inspector. Keys are organised into categories (Default, Popups, Store, Tutorials, …) inside a catalog asset edited from a full editor window. Drop LocalizedText / LocalizedTMPText on a GameObject to localize UI without writing code. Built for zero per-frame cost: keys resolve once, a language switch swaps a single array reference, and reads never allocate. Local catalogs today, with a source interface and CSV import ready for Google Sheets and other remote providers.

samples.description: A catalog with four categories and three languages, a language switcher, attribute-bound scripts and localized uGUI/TMP components in a runtime scene. Includes a Tools menu item that builds the scene programmatically.
